# 方位介词演示盒
pos = 1   # 1 on 2 in 3 under

hide()
prep = "on"
sent = "The cat is on the box."
cn = "猫在盒子上面（表面接触）"
py = 55
inside = 0
if pos == 2:
    prep = "in"
    sent = "The cat is in the box."
    cn = "猫在盒子里面（被包围）"
    py = 0
    inside = 1
if pos == 3:
    prep = "under"
    sent = "The cat is under the box."
    cn = "猫在盒子下面（下方）"
    py = -62
fill_rect(0, 120, 360, 32, "#1d4ed8")
write(sent, 0, 120, "#fff", 14)
if inside == 1:
    fill_rect(0, 20, 130, 90, "#f59e0b")
    fill_rect(0, -20, 130, 16, "#b45309")
    write("🐱", 0, py, "#0f172a", 24)
if inside == 0:
    write("🐱", 0, py, "#0f172a", 24)
    fill_rect(0, -20, 130, 50, "#f59e0b")
    fill_rect(0, 5, 130, 14, "#b45309")
fill_rect(0, 78, 360, 30, "#f1f5f9")
write(cn + "（介词：" + prep + "）", 0, 78, "#0f172a", 11)
write("问：Where is the cat?   答：It is " + prep + " the box.", -10, -80, "#dc2626", 11)
write("动物单词：cat dog bird duck pig bear panda tiger", 0, -108, "#0369a1", 10)

sections.title: 动物单词
sections.body:
【cat 猫 · dog 狗 · bird 鸟 · duck 鸭 · pig 猪 · bear 熊 · panda 熊猫 · tiger 老虎】
复数加 s：cats, dogs, birds（注意 duck→ducks）。
句型：I like cats. They are cute.

sections.title: 方位三兄弟
sections.body:
【on：在…上面（表面接触）——on the box】
【in：在…里面（被包围）——in the box】
【under：在…下面——under the box】
动作演示：把手 on 桌上、in 口袋、under 桌子——身体记忆最牢。

sections.title: Where is 句型
sections.body:
【问：Where is the cat? 单数 / Where are the cats? 复数】
【答：It is on the box. / They are under the box.】
问答要配套：is 问 it 答，are 问 they 答。
拓展：near（旁边）behind（后面）——捉迷藏英语全靠它。

steps: 主语 the cat 单数用 is
The cat is in the box.

examples.q: Where are the birds? 怎么回答？
steps: 注意复数 are/they 配套

mistakes: on 和 in 混用（树上鸟用 in the tree）
Where is the cats（单复数不一致）

exercises.q: The cat is ___ the box.（在盒子上面）
Where ___ the dog? It is under the chair.
They are ___ the tree.（鸟在树上）
